scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build: cd server && npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && node prisma/seed.js && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
